	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_2
	construction_time = construction_time_9_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 2
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = entrepot_prosperity_tier_2
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_silk_sell_price_mult = entrepot_sell_price_tier_2
		trade_good_textiles_sell_price_mult = entrepot_sell_price_tier_2
		trade_good_ceramics_sell_price_mult = entrepot_sell_price_tier_2
		trade_good_glass_sell_price_mult = entrepot_sell_price_tier_2
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_silk
		amount = entrepot_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 10
		skip_internal_fulfillment = yes
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_silk_production_flat = entrepot_need_amount
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_textiles
		amount = entrepot_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 10
		skip_internal_fulfillment = yes
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_textiles_production_flat = entrepot_need_amount
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_ceramics
		amount = entrepot_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 10
		skip_internal_fulfillment = yes
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_ceramics_production_flat = entrepot_need_amount
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_glass
		amount = entrepot_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 10
		skip_internal_fulfillment = yes
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_glass_production_flat = entrepot_need_amount
			}
		}
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 9.1
		ai_economic_terrain_modifier = yes
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.3
			province_size_level < 4
		}
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_economical_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_urban_building_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 2 }
	}
}
